properties.summary: Anthony kept all four as intent, each as its cheap option: an unknown tool name answered with find_tools on its own words; a refused relation word pointed at the tool that draws its edge, with glosses never cut mid-list; every hook keeps a local log of what it returned; an approver known to a pinned design is named in the refusal. A family-wide who-is-who stays considered.
